stories.title: Broadcast polls: admin pushes an opinion poll that blocks signed-in users until they answer
stories.notes: Built: admin creates and opens a poll at any time (up to 5 questions, single, multi or 5-point scale, optional Telugu wording, optional auto-close within 30 days, at most 3 open); every signed-in non-admin sees a blocking, inert-background dialog (focus trap, Escape does nothing, English or Telugu) until every question is answered, 'prefer not to say' on every question; one answer per account; admin results with per-option counts hidden below 10 answers; admin can close any time. Stored as per-option counters plus a keyed 'answered' marker, no person id and no per-response rows. It is NOT a Pulse Survey: no eligibility, weighting or representativeness, and every screen says so. Refuses party or candidate choice wording, links and requests for codes or IDs. NOT done: a single admin can push (no second approver, no counsel review of the mandatory-answer design), no targeting by place or role, no push to people who are signed out (they see it at next sign-in), no email or SMS nudge, no published figures, admin screen is English only, Telugu text is machine-drafted and unreviewed. Whether forcing an answer is acceptable under the consent notice is a counsel question.

stories.title: Scheduled start time for broadcast polls
stories.notes: Built: an admin can set a start time up to 30 days ahead; the poll is listed as scheduled, blocks nobody and refuses answers until then, then goes live by itself (users see it within about 30 seconds on an open page); it can be cancelled before it starts; the end time must follow the start and be within 30 days of it; scheduled polls count toward the limit of 3. A start in the past or empty means now. NOT done: editing a poll after it is created, repeating polls, time zone choice (the picker uses the admin's browser time), a reminder to the admin before it starts.

stories.title: Recorded admin and user automation journey for broadcast polls
stories.notes: Built: one Playwright journey with two recorded browser contexts (admin and user), saved as separate 1280x720 .webm files by npm run e2e:poll-videos. Covers write and push, blocked dialog, partial answers, prefer-not behaviour, release, no re-ask, response count, results hidden below 10 answers, close. NOT done: videos are not published anywhere or attached to CI, Telugu and mobile are not recorded, the scheduled-start flow is covered by other specs but not in the video.

stories.title: Minimum choices field on the admin poll screen

Covered by a unit test and the recorded journey. NOT done: English-only admin label; the Telugu dialog wording for the range is machine-drafted and unreviewed.
